result.reason: The clause provides the fallback 90-day transition period at then-current rates, but it does not require a data export within 30 days or specify a standard machine-readable format. “Thereafter return or certifiably destroy” is ambiguous as to timing, sequence, and whether deletion certification is actually required. The added obligation to deliver all source code, documentation, and credentials goes beyond the transition/data-return rule and may materially expand Contractor’s IP and operational handover obligations, so the revision is not minimal and may disturb unrelated commercial intent.
